mapping.title: text and layout utilities
mapping.note: `.mono` is the one genuinely new utility: an address or a symbol inline in prose is TYPE, not a box, so `.cm-inline-code` is the wrong answer. `.muted small` is `.cm-hint` (opacity) plus `--text-sm`; oem-ui deliberately has no `.small` class, because a component owns its own size rather than inheriting one from the author.

mapping.title: action buttons
mapping.note: One base plus modifiers. `.sm` and `.small-btn` are the same variant; `.as-btn` is a link wearing button clothes, which is `.cm-btn` on an `<a>`.

mapping.title: app shell and sidebar rail
mapping.note: decomp splits the rail into nav-top / nav-scroll / nav-foot, which is `__header` / `__content` / `__footer`. `.nav-shade` is `__scrim`; `.nav-close` and `.nav-update` are `__header` controls. A project entry in the rail is a `.cm-row`, and an empty rail is `.cm-state`.

mapping.title: page frame
mapping.note: `page-head` is `.cm-head` (kicker, title, sub). `.cols` and `.stack-col` are `.cm-cols` and `.cm-stack`.

mapping.title: import surface
mapping.note: **The drop target is the one new component.** `.cm-dropzone` carries `--over`, `--picked`, `--busy` and `--err`, plus a `__platforms` row for the formats it accepts; decomp's four `drop-*` classes are exactly those four states. `.privacy` is `.cm-hint`, and `.lz-custom` is `.cm-disclosure`.

mapping.title: project header
mapping.note: `ph-row` / `ph-title` / `ph-actions` are exactly `.cm-head-row` plus `__text` plus `.cm-push-group`. That component exists because hand-rolled versions of this row drift one block at a time; see its comment in components.css.

mapping.title: KPIs and the ROM map
mapping.note: The map is a canvas plus `.cm-tooltip`. Every chart is one `.cm-chart` with `__line` / `__area` / `__bar--stacked`, and the legend is `.cm-chart__legend` - there is no standalone `.cm-legend`, and adding one would split the series colours away from the chart that owns them. `.autopilot` / `.ap-icon` / `.ap-text` are `.cm-status`; `.next` is `.cm-alert`.

mapping.title: sortable table
mapping.note: `sorted` is `aria-sort` on `.cm-table__sort`, never a colour class: the direction is drawn from the attribute, so a screen reader hears it as well as seeing it.

mapping.title: agent launcher and sessions
mapping.note: A session is `.cm-rows--stacked` (title over detail over meta); the launcher is `.cm-stepper` driving `.cm-field` rows.

mapping.title: feeds
mapping.note: The chronological feed is `.cm-timeline`; agent chatter carrying an author and a timestamp is `.cm-msglist`, which already owns grouped messages, reactions and unread rails.

mapping.title: settings panes
mapping.note: `danger-zone` is a `.cm-section` whose action is `.cm-btn--danger`. There is no red-bordered box, on purpose: the system carries severity by glyph and weight, never by hue.

mapping.title: public decomps and tools
mapping.note: Both card grids are `.cm-cards`; a repo-URL row with a trailing button is `.cm-input-group`.

mapping.title: function inspector
mapping.note: decomp's inspector card is `.cm-dialog` (head, body, title). The editor is `.cm-code-input`: a textarea over a highlighted `pre`, which is exactly what decomp hand-rolls with `.editor` plus `.edit-bar`. `.dfolded` is `.cm-diff__fold`.

mapping.title: phone breakpoints
mapping.note: No class of its own: these are the app's own media-query behaviours, and every oem-ui component here already carries its own breakpoints. Porting them as classes would duplicate the system's responsive decisions in the consumer.

mapping.title: classes only app.js emits
mapping.note: Markup fragments the JS builds at runtime. Each resolves to the component above rather than to a class of its own.
